candidates.name: Kimpton Hotel & Restaurant Group
candidates.description: ▌進軍亞太首站臺北 - 金普頓大安酒店 Kimpton Da An Hotel 隱身於臺北東區靜謐街巷內，亞太首間的金普頓大安酒店以細緻而富有人情味的服務及廣受好評的餐廳，在酒店界中享有盛譽。與購物中心和捷運站僅隔一個街區，獨特地理位置，攘往熙來人潮看似近在咫尺，卻猶如世外桃源般與世隔絕。各式迷人充滿詩意的人文咖啡館、個性精品店與文藝畫廊，散落酒店周圍。 擁有129間客房的金普頓大安酒於2019年第一季開幕。在設計方面邀請到位於上海的如恩設計研究室操刀，創始合夥人郭錫恩先生和胡如珊女士曾榮獲EDIDA國際設計大獎年度設計師，Wallpaper*雜誌評選最佳年度設計師等殊榮。設計靈感以兼具臺北街景中混亂與秩序並存的景象為出發，跳脫傳統的設計界限融入臺灣文化特色，進行全然不同的詮釋。當步入位於12樓的英式餐酒館，可瞧見風情萬種的亞熱帶陽光灑落在寬敞戶外露台，除了可放鬆品酩美酒佳餚外，令人醉心的台北城景與聳入天際的台北101盡收眼底，徹底讓賓客體驗與挖掘新舊台北魅力與脈動。而金普頓大安酒店也將延續品牌享譽世界的餐廳名號，餐廳及酒吧將與旗下擁有曾榮獲米其林肯定的都爹利會館、22Ships、Aberdeen Street Social等知名餐廳的佳民集團合作，為旅客提供感官的極致饗宴，亦為臺北提供新一美食打卡聖地。 ▌Tucked away from the main street and only steps away from Zhongxiao Fuxing MRT station, Kimpton Da An stands still between tradition and modernity, frenetic energy and slow pace. The walkable neighborhood has a buzzing energy as people flow in and out of the city. Each corner, turn, or block is a journey of discoveries infused with sophistication and tranquility. A definitive sanctuary for discerning travelers seeking understated luxury, the 129 serene rooms demonstrate a designer's piece itself and hum the melody of calm and beauty. At our cozy lobby living room, start your day with the famous Morning Kick- Start or chill out and recharge during the Wine Hour. Embrace Taipei's skyline at our rooftop terrace or wine & dine in our modern restaurant, The Tavernist. Join our curate biking or hiking tour to live like a local and feel the beauty of authenticity. It is where you feel a sense of belonging and the true Taiwanese hospitality.
candidates.rationale: Both operate hotel and hospitality brands offering lodging and guest experiences to travelers seeking accommodations.

candidates.name: Yotel
candidates.description: With 23 properties in sought-after locations globally, YOTEL is for people on the move. People who are experiencing, doing and achieving; Non-Stop. From buzzing cities to bustling airports, YOTEL exists to challenge the status quo of the hospitality industry and deliver a different experience for guests through smart design, creative technology, and awesome people. YOTEL is the pit stop for the Non-Stop. The global hospitality brand is based in London with regional offices in the US and Asia and has a portfolio of three brands: YOTEL (city centre hotels), YOTELPAD (extended stay option) and YOTELAIR (airport hotels). The company operates fourteen city centre hotels in New York, Boston, San Francisco, Washington DC, Miami, Singapore, Tokyo, Edinburgh, London (2), Amsterdam, Porto, Glasgow and Manchester, and six airport hotels in London Gatwick, Amsterdam Schiphol, Paris, Charles de Gaulle, Istanbul Airport (2), and Singapore Changi. YOTEL’s major shareholders include Talal Jassim Al-Bahar Group, United Investment Portugal, and Kuwait Real Estate Company (AQARAT). YOTEL was originally created by YO! founder Simon Woodroffe OBE who took inspiration from the experience of first-class travel and translated that ethos, language and design into small but beautifully designed rooms. www.yo.co.uk.
candidates.rationale: YOTEL is a global hotel operator with city, extended-stay, and airport lodging brands, directly overlapping Marriott’s hospitality and accommodations business.

Our aim is to provide extremely good value for money at a time when it has become an increasingly important factor to companies and individuals when making buying decisions. Jersey.

candidates.description: Mr & Mrs Smith (a nod to the classic check-in nom de plume for illicit stays of old) began life in 2003 and has evolved into a global travel club with more than a million like-minded members. candidates.name: Shilo Inns
candidates.description: Shilo Inns was founded in 1974, and today, has 15 convenient hotel locations in 7 Western states and Texas, as well as 7 restaurants. Shilo Inns is considered the largest private, independently owned and operated hospitality company in the Western United States. Mark S. Hemstreet, Founder and Owner of Shilo Inns, learned a lot about the hospitality business from his mother and father. He demonstrated his entrepreneurial abilities at the age of 16 as summer manager of a small motel. He cultivated an early vision of developing the best independent hotel/motel/resort chain in the Pacific Northwest. The results of that experience, and dream, culminated in his officially opening the first Shilo Inn at age 24, in 1974. Mr. Hemstreet contributes most of Shilo's success to the hard work and dedication of Shilo Employees, that truly enjoy pampering our guests with Shilo's special brand of hospitality. Each Shilo Inn has been designed to offer quality guest comfort at an affordable price. In-room amenities include free high speed Internet access in every room, first-run movies & entertainment, hair dryers, clock radios, microwaves, refrigerators, wet bars, coffee makers and ironing units. Most Shilo Inns have pools, spas, steam and sauna rooms. Fitness-oriented travelers enjoy Shilo Inns'​ fully-equipped exercise rooms. Many of the indoor recreation facilities are open 24 hours a day. Shilo's business travelers appreciate the complimentary amenities, such as dual phone lines, data ports, incoming fax service and free local calls & 800 number access. Guests enjoy a complimentary continental or full breakfast at many Shilo Inns. And, Shilo offers a choice between free major airline miles or Shilo's Star Reward. Shilo offers free high speed Internet access in all guest rooms and suites, as well as through out the entire hotel, restaurant, meeting and banquet facilities!
candidates.rationale: Shilo Inns operates a hotel and lodging chain serving travelers, directly overlapping Marriott’s core hospitality business and guest market.

candidates.name: Tripnow
candidates.description: Fundada en Cancún, México, en 2016, somos la agencia de viajes con las tarifas más competitivas del Caribe, con las más innovadoras plataformas de reservaciones de México y una de las agencias con mayor crecimiento en Latinoamérica. Desde hace más 6 años al servicio de nuestros clientes, en Tripnow.mx tuvimos el sueño de cambiar la forma de viajar en nuestro país; ofreciendo una oferta completa de hoteles, vuelos, paquetes de viaje y productos relacionados con el turismo en todo el mundo y adaptándolos a los deseos y necesidades de cada viajero, tanto personal como de negocios, y siempre sin perder el excelente trato y garantía de calidad como nuestras fuerzas competitivas. El éxito de nuestro modelo multiservicios, multidestinos y apostando por la tarifa más competitiva del mercado se ha traducido en un acelerado crecimiento: tenemos más de 6 años cambiando la forma de reservar y viajar de nuestro país y queremos seguir haciéndolo. Nos sentimos comprometidos con nuestros clientes, con nuestros colaboradores, con nuestros proveedores, con nuestra comunidad, con nuestra industria y con la sociedad en general y creemos que generar valor y cambio es la mejor forma de contribuir a su desarrollo. Gracias por creer en nosotros. ¡Ahora es cuando, vamos por más! www.tripnow.mx

Nuestro mayor valor es el equipo humano, un grupo de profesionales comprometidos con la excelencia, quienes año tras año avalan nuestra dedicación hacia el bienestar de nuestros huéspedes. Su pasión y esfuerzo son el motor que impulsa nuestra búsqueda constante por ofrecer experiencias memorables y un servicio de calidad en cada detalle. Además, en Evenia Hotels trabajamos con un fuerte compromiso hacia la sostenibilidad. Todos nuestros hoteles de propiedad cuentan con el Certificado Bioscore, que garantiza nuestra gestión responsable y ecoeficiente. A través de nuestro programa Ecoevenia, implementamos iniciativas para mejorar continuamente la sostenibilidad en cada uno de nuestros establecimientos, minimizando el impacto ambiental y optimizando el uso de recursos. En cada estancia, no solo proporcionamos confort y calidad, sino también una experiencia auténtica, cuidando tanto a nuestros huéspedes como al entorno que nos rodea.

Especialista en gestión y dirección de empresas turísticas, ocupa la presidencia del holding Inversiones Hosteleras de Galicia, gestora de la marca comercial OCA Hotels. A nivel nacional OCA Hotels está presente en Galicia, en sus cuatro provincias, con hoteles en Compostela, Rías Baixas, A Mariña, Ribeira Sacra, Palas de Rei, Sarria, Ourense y Allariz; en Asturias con hoteles en Oviedo, Gijón y Avilés. A nivel internacional la línea está presente en Portugal y en Brasil a través de un complejo turístico.
candidates.rationale: Oca Hotels operates and manages a multi-brand hotel portfolio across economy, midscale, and upscale segments, directly overlapping Marriott’s core hospitality business.

candidates.name: VeryChic
candidates.description: VeryChic est le leader européen des ventes privées de voyages extraordinaires. Nous parcourons la planète pour identifier les meilleurs hôtels du monde, négocier auprès d'eux des réductions exclusives pour nos abonnés et transformer les rêves d'évasion de nos clients en voyages de rêve. 3 millions de clients nous ont fait confiance depuis la création de l'entreprise en 2011, et plus de 8,000 hôtels de luxe dans 82 pays nous confient la distribution de leurs chambres inoccupées. L'entrée du groupe Accor au capital de notre société en 2017 garantit à nos membres un accès exclusif à un portefeuille d'adresses d'exception. Raffles, Fairmont, MGallery, Orient-Express, Sofitel, Delano, Mondrian... pour ne citer qu'elles, font partie des marques hôtelières pour lesquelles nous organisons 6,500 ventes privées chaque année. L'expertise de nos 150 collaborateurs, l'excellence de nos partenaires hôteliers et la garantie d'une expérience remarquable pour les 10 millions d'abonnés à nos newsletters sont les piliers sur lesquels repose notre marque. Nous accueillons en permanence des professionnels expérimentés et ambitieux, des joueurs d'équipe exigeants et bienveillants, des femmes et des hommes passionnés par l'innovation et l'industrie du voyage pour mettre cette promesse en œuvre : pour rejoindre cette aventure humaine, prenez contact avec nous. VeryChic, les chiffres clés : 150 collaborateurs (Paris, Barcelone) 3M d'applications installées 3M de clients 10M d'abonnés à nos newsletters 8,000 partenaires hôteliers 200M€ de chiffre d'affaires

candidates.name: Aka
candidates.description: Welcome to The World's Most Livable Hotels. AKA offers sophisticated hotel accommodations and spacious furnished residences with exceptional business, wellness, and lifestyle amenities in iconic neighborhoods. As leaders in long stay living, we have introduced our core residential philosophies to evolve the hotel category into a high-quality experience that is more livable. AKA accommodations reflect a tranquil and sophisticated design that strikes the perfect balance between the privacy and contentment of a residence and the hospitality, service, and style of an intimate hotel, so it has touches of residential living. AKA is a division of Korman Communities, a four generation family-run real estate business since 1909 and pioneer of the furnished suite concept in 1966.

candidates.description: The Indismart Group focuses on two main areas of enterprise: Education and Hospitality. Partnerships with Edinburgh Napier University, Scotland and Thames Valley University, England enable us to deliver a top quality education experience. Our own business school, ISB Kolkata is educating India's future business leaders. We have our own hotels in Kolkata, New Delhi and Goa. Our Kolkata and Delhi properties benefit from city centre locations that make them the choice of the smart traveller. Our Woodbourne Hill resort in Goa is a great place to relax or take time as a group to focus and make strategy in a beautiful natural setting.

Convierte tus sueños en realidad y disfruta de privilegios únicos, servicios de primera clase y una atención personalizada en cada uno de tus viajes.

candidates.name: Treebo Hotels
candidates.description: We are a 'digital hotel company'. To borrow and extend Steve Jobs' words - we work with the mind of an engineer and the heart of a hotelier. This is best evident in our two business units - "Treebo Club" and "Hotel Superhero". Treebo Hotels is India's most loved hotel chain in the premium-budget segment. We have used technology to drive quality control at scale in the economy segment of hotel industry, which was so far unorganised and fragmented. We offer travellers a safe, clean, comfortable accommodation at affordable prices. We are rated 7.8/10 by customers, miles ahead of other players. We have 600+ hotels across 100+ cities under our brand. Hotel Superhero is our brand-new, super-exciting, pure-play technology business. Over the years, we realised that the tech solutions we had built for our own use at Treebo were truly cutting edge and unparalleled in the industry. So we decided to externalise and monetise them as a SaaS business. As part of Hotel Superhero we offer an integrated, intuitive, and extremely powerful hotel management software which takes care of all technology needs of hotels. We offer central reservation system, property management system, revenue manager, channel manager, and a lot more as part of an all-in-one solution. Our target clients are anyone and everyone running a hospitality business - whether these are boutique hotels, vacation rentals, mid-sized chains, hostels, or large global chains. We have global ambitions with this business and have already developed clients outside India for this business. Hotel Superhero is the business we are actively hiring tech talent for. We are a small team with big ambitions. Joining the Hotel Superhero team could be a great opportunity to get step-up opportunities to build meaty, challenging products. We pride ourselves for building a company with a fantastic culture and highly accomplished base of current and past employees. Check out our other pages here to know more.

candidates.name: Best Western Hotels
candidates.description: Welcome to Hallmark Hotels. Our portfolio includes hotels all over the UK. Each one is a little bit different – as you would expect, a hotel overlooking the beaches at Bournemouth isn’t the same as a hotel in the centre of Glasgow or Manchester. Wherever you are, you’ll be reassured to know that there are certain aspects you will recognise, whichever Hallmark Hotel you check in to. You will receive a warm welcome from friendly, professional staff. Your bedroom will be fitted with all of the amenities that you need for a comfortable, enjoyable stay and you will be able to book a table in the restaurant knowing that you’ll experience high-quality cuisine from a team dedicated to delivering great value food using the very best of fresh, seasonal ingredients. You might be staying with us on business, or you could be taking a break with your partner or family. Maybe you are looking for a venue with function rooms to hold your wedding, party or a business conference or event. All of our Hallmark Hotels have fantastic rooms which can be booked for a wide range of functions, so just give our team a call. Whatever you are looking for, you’re in a good place, where service, value and some of the UK’s best locations combine to create the Hallmark of great hospitality. We look forward to welcoming you. (Profile image is the Hallmark Hotel The Welcombe, Stratford-upon-Avon)

candidates.name: A by Adina
candidates.description: A little luxe, a little laid back. Step inside, and you’ll find that perfectly suited balance between a hotel and residential experience. In our world, no two hotels are alike. Imagine architecture that tells its own unique story, with all the space you need to write yours. It’s the freedom to discover a new city, or just stay in and lounge the night away. From business trips of virtually any length, to next-level staycations or family getaways with that extra bit of wow-factor. With us, it’s always personal because we’re anything but one-size-fits all, we’re the smart choice that makes every stay feel just right. Welcome to a new way to stay. We know that different stays shouldn’t need a different hotel every time. That’s why we created the brand-new concept of Hotel Living. Expect detail in every detail. Designer amenities and little surprises that make every day a bit more luxe. And all the freedom that comes with having your own special place in the heart of the city. A by Adina is the place where confident travellers chose to experience the best of both worlds, while also having access to world class dining and bars. Find us in Sydney & Canberra, Australia. Part of TFE Hotels.
